name: Intro to Boxing — Session 1
intent: First exposure: establish a base, a guard, and one punch. No contact beyond a held mitt.
coach_notes: Deliberately short on content. First sessions fail from volume, not from too little material.

name: Beginner Footwork
intent: Build step-drag and lateral movement before any punch is attached to them.

name: Beginner Straight Punches
intent: Jab and cross from a stable base, with the weight transfer taught before the rear hand.

name: Intermediate Movement and Angles
intent: Pivot and angle-cutting against a moving reference.

name: Intermediate Combinations — Random Practice
intent: Combination work with sequences called at random rather than blocked, following the contextual-interference retention evidence.
coach_notes: Random calling is deliberate. Blocked practice looks better in the session and retains worse — though note the contextual-interference evidence is contested in applied settings.

name: Defensive Foundations
intent: Catch, parry, slip and roll at controlled speed, each linked back to guard.

name: Conditioned Sparring Session
intent: Single-task conditioned sparring with defined roles. Requires coach authorization and confirmed eligibility.
coach_notes: No sparring volume is prescribed. The coach sets rounds and intensity in person, against this athlete on this day, with medical and eligibility status confirmed by qualified humans.

name: Adaptive Session — Seated Base
intent: Technical boxing from a seated or supported base, with range set to the athlete.
coach_notes: Not a reduced version of a standing session. Base is defined with the athlete; the technical target is the same.

name: Non-Contact Fitness Boxing
intent: Boxing-style conditioning for participants not pursuing contact. A complete lane, not a preparatory stage.

name: Strength and Power Support
intent: Off-floor strength supporting boxing demands, balancing the pushing volume boxing accumulates.
coach_notes: Horizontal pull is included specifically to offset punching and pressing volume.

name: Advanced Tactical Problem Solving
intent: Imposed tactical problems with the athlete identifying and addressing them.

name: Youth Session — Movement and Play
intent: Youth-appropriate session prioritising movement variety and engagement over technical volume.
coach_notes: Content is deliberately light. Youth retention is an engagement problem before it is a technical one.
